DROP TABLE "public"."User"

CREATE TABLE "public"."assignment" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deadline" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "facultyId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "totalMarks" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."assignmentSubmission" (
  "assignmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "feedback" text,
  "fileUrl" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "marks" float8,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "submittedAt" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."attendance" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auditLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entity" text NOT NULL,
  "entityId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ipAddress" text,
  "newData" json,
  "oldData" json,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."classSchedule" (
  "building" text,
  "dayOfWeek" int4 NOT NULL,
  "endTime" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "room" text,
  "sectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "startTime" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."course" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "credit" float8 NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "programId" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."department" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "facultyName" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."enrollment" (
  "enrolledAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ENROLLED' NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "enrollment_status_check_06bd3931" CHECK ("status" IN ('ENROLLED', 'DROPPED', 'COMPLETED', 'WITHDRAWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."exam" (
  "examDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "facultyId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "sectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "totalMarks" float8 NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "exam_type_check_edabfdf5" CHECK ("type" IN ('MIDTERM', 'FINAL', 'QUIZ', 'PRACTICAL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."faculty" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "designation" text NOT NULL,
  "employeeId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "joiningDate" timestamptz,
  "specialization" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."invoice" (
  "amount" float8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "invoiceNo" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "invoice_status_check_ffce4837" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isRead" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notification_type_check_7e424632" CHECK ("type" IN ('INFO', 'WARNING', 'ERROR'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payment" (
  "amount" float8 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "invoiceId" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payment_method_check_8d418564" CHECK ("method" IN ('CASH', 'CARD', 'ONLINE', 'BANK_TRANSFER')),
  CONSTRAINT "payment_status_check_770d43e6" CHECK ("status" IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'PENDING'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."program" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "departmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "durationYears" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "totalCredits" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."result" (
  "enrollmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "examId" text,
  "grade" text NOT NULL,
  "gradePoint" float8 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "marks" float8 NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."section" (
  "capacity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "courseId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "facultyId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "semesterId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."semester" (
  "endDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "year" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "semester_status_check_998b1e1c" CHECK ("status" IN ('UPCOMING', 'ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."student" (
  "address" text,
  "admissionYear" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currentSemester" int4 NOT NULL,
  "currentYear" int4 NOT NULL,
  "dateOfBirth" timestamptz,
  "departmentId" text NOT NULL,
  "gender" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "programId" text NOT NULL,
  "studentId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastLoginAt" timestamptz,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password" text,
  "phone" text,
  "photoUrl" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'STUDENT' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_role_check_0e82dd91" CHECK ("role" IN ('STUDENT', 'FACULTY', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')),
  CONSTRAINT "user_status_check_f9d721b2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'BLOCKED'))
)
